newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE GETS FRESH LISTINGS.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE GETS FRESH LISTINGS.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Wednesday two new companies would join in trading this week, bringing to 43 the total number of listings.
The newcomers -- bakery Mopan and Apcarom plumbing company -- will join the bourse's second tier on June 19 and June 20 respectively, an exchange statement said.

Mopan has a share capital of around 9.8 billion lei, in shares with a nominal value of 25,000 lei each. Individual shareholders, including company staff, have a stake of 59.96 percent and the State Ownership Fund (FPS) holds the rest.
Apcarom has some 34.6 billion lei in capital, in shares with a face value of 1,000 lei each.

The FPS is Apcarom's main stockholder with 51.77 percent. A stake of 28.77 percent went to individual shareholders in a public offer and 19.44 percent were acquired by individuals in a mass selloff. Managers have the rest.
The Bucharest stock exchange lists seven stocks on its first tier. ($=7,232 lei)
